verdict.rationale: The evidence implies fleet-style operation but does not show documented concurrency limits. Daytona describes itself as elastic infrastructure, claims millisecond sandbox spin-up and shutdown, and documents warm pools that keep a configured number of pre-created running sandboxes. Nothing in the pack states how many sandboxes can run at once or what the quotas and rate limits are. missing for 10: documented concurrency limits/quotas, explicit large-fleet concurrency guidance, independent or hands-on evidence of large concurrent fleets.
